description:
SOC Property present to the market this immaculate home, which stands on an elevated site with a fully landscaped gardens and a spectacular patio area featuring a water feature.

An impressive B Energy Rating giving access to a Greener Mortgage.

The property, which is in show home condition throughout, has a bespoke finish and is laid out over two levels, with the main living areas boasting 10ft ceilings.

The four bedrooms are laid out over two floors, with one bedroom having recently been converted into a kitchen creating a useful space with potential for additional rental income or indeed a self-contained area for a family member, as a patio door leading off this kitchen area would provide separate access.

In addition to the main house, the property has the benefit of two large sheds  with dedicated offices space,  fitted out with two offices ( both offices fully insulated ), opens this home up to a massive variety of business, creative, or practical possibilities, a covered over canopy area suitable for housing a motorhome or caravan. 

The property benefits from access to high-speed fibre broadband, it is fully alarmed with CCTV cameras throughout.
